title: Somapacitan Is Effective and Well Tolerated in Chinese Children with Growth Hormone Deficiency: A Randomized Controlled Phase 3 Study.
authors: Fu J, Cheng X, Højby M, Gong C, Leunbach TL, Li Y, Wei H, Zhu Y, Zhang Y, Zhong Y, REAL6 study group.
figures: REAL6 trial design and profile. REAL6 is designed as a randomized, open-labelled, active-controlled parallel group phase 3 trial. Children with GHD (110) were randomized 2:1 and exposed to once-weekly somapacitan (0.16 mg/kg/week;  n  = 74) or daily GH (0.034 mg/kg/day;  n  = 36), both administered subcutaneously.
